lines.text: Moses says Israel will cross the Jordan against strong, tall Anakim, but the LORD goes ahead of them as a consuming fire.
Moses says the LORD drives out the nations because of their wickedness, not Israel's righteousness, since Israel is a stiff-necked people.
Moses stays on Horeb forty days and forty nights, then the LORD tells him the people have made a molten lamb.
Moses shatters the tablets, then burns the calf, grinds it to dust and casts it into a stream.
Moses chisels two new tablets, and the LORD writes the Ten Commandments on them, and Moses keeps them in his tent.

wrong_details.wrong: Moses keeps them in his tent
wrong_details.true: Moses placed the tablets in the ark he had made
